name: Chicago Public Library teen assistantships (Teen Best Reads, Teen Gamer's Guild, Teen Media Lab)
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: These are paid teen assistantships at the library. You pick and promote the year's best teen books. Or you plan a free gaming convention. Or you make social media content in YOUmedia. Teens meet weekly or monthly and finish projects.
who_can_apply: Must live in the City of Chicago and attend a Chicago high school. Ages 14 to 19 on the start date of Jan 9, 2027. Teen Best Reads and Teen Media Lab are open to current 9th, 10th and 11th graders.
pay_detail: Paid by stipend. Teen Best Reads pays $3,500. Teen Gamer's Guild pays $1,800. Teen Media Lab pays $2,200 for spring and $1,300 for fall. You get paid for finishing work and going to meetings.
duration: Starts Jan 9, 2027. Gamer's Guild to June 10; Media Lab Jan to June 22 and Sept 7 to Dec 14; Best Reads to Dec 14.
deadline_text: Applications open Monday Oct 19, 2026 and close Sunday Nov 8, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Chicago Public Library form, not the After School Matters site. Answer the open questions with care. They decide who gets an interview. Each program has a video interview in Microsoft Teams. You can apply to as many as you like. You can only accept one.
notes: In the first month you enroll with After School Matters. That needs a Social Security Number and a parent or guardian's details. Questions: teenservices@chipublib.org. Gamer's Guild groups meet at different library branches. The sub-pages list these stipends. Teen Best Reads pays $3,500 for finishing work and showing up. Teen Media Lab pays $2,200 for Spring and $1,300 for Fall. The Best Reads page is dated 2025 and gives no year. So the 2026-27 cycle rests on the main page.
